seoCopy.title: Weekly Events in Oceanside, CA
body: The Lobby Tiki Bar keeps the week moving. Every Tuesday is Tiki Taco Tuesday — $6 tacos and $5 wells from open to close, paired with island-inspired tacos. Monday through Friday we run happy hour with discounted cocktails, beer, wine, and bites — Monday is all-day happy hour.
Inside The Brick Hotel on Pier View Way, steps from the Oceanside Pier. The kind of weekly ritual a neighborhood bar is supposed to provide.
